## `XenoComponent` { #xenocomponent-struct }

`public struct XenoComponent`

Lightweight, stack-allocated handle to an entity in the ECS. Returned by `Compose` factory methods. Modifiers mutate the entity's slab data in-place through the static `Engine` reference. 8 bytes total (int Id + bool _valid) — zero heap allocation.

**Properties**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `XenoComponent None { get; }` | Sentinel for conditional rendering. `default(XenoComponent)` is also None. Usage: `condition ? Text("Hello") : XenoComponent.None` |
| `bool IsNone { get; }` | True if this represents a skipped/conditional-null component. All modifiers are no-ops on None — enables safe chaining in conditional paths. |
